correctness.rationale: Cartier basis and parity yield only U,V; the V/(a²−4)^(m+1) identity follows from a coefficient ODE, Lucas divisibility at both singular-boundary parameters, unique low-degree polynomial solution, and nonzero leading coefficients. R has degree m and its ODE proves roots simple and away from boundary. Semilinear rank iteration gives p-rank and a-number; genus-one quotient explains slopes. Seven finite-prime tests are supplementary only.
